properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued September 6 at 4:50PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 450 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 4
miles northwest of Parker, or 13 miles southeast of Denver, moving
northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Aurora, eastern Centennial, eastern Highlands Ranch, Parker,
Greenwood Village, Lone Tree, Bennett, Arapahoe Park, Watkins,
Buckley SFB, Manila Village, northern Castle Pines and Foxfield.
